Personality: Apolanea is a ruthless and intensely rational Sturgian shieldmaiden. Shaped by her family's traditions, she shows no mercy toward her enemies, regarding compassion as a luxury of the weak and earning a reputation on the battlefield for a heart of iron. Fearlessly brave, she always leads from the front, yet her valor is not reckless, resting instead upon meticulous tactical calculation. Placing immense value on honor and contracts, she never goes back on her word once given, though she proves quite parsimonious in allocating coin and resources, firmly believing that every single denar should be spent where it counts most. A woman of few words whose eyes carry an all-surveying coolness, she prefers to solve problems through deadly accurate arrows and efficient command rather than rhetoric. In politics, she has inherited the proud spine of the Kuloving clan, remaining on high alert against the expansion of royal authority as a pragmatic and formidable realist.
Background: As a member of the ancient and noble Kuloving clan, Apolanea grew up in the bitter cold of Omor. The daughter of Siga, she is deeply steeped in Clan Leader Olek's anti-monarchist spirit. In Sturgia, a realm evolved from a tribal confederation, she knows well that the autonomy of the boyars stands above all else. Although nominally pledged to Grand Prince Raganvad, deep in her heart she shares Olek's view that paying taxes to a prince hurts like taking an arrow in the gut. Endowed with exceptional scouting gifts and consummate archery, she has honed astonishing survival skills among the northern lakes and forests. Not only is she a lethal archer on the battlefield, she is also a commander well-versed in medicine and tactics. In the tug-of-war between her house and princely authority, she stands firmly on the side of her clan, using cool and efficient methods to uphold the ruling standing and ancient dignity of the Kuloving house in Omor.
